voce.definizioneEN: A body appointed by a Member State according to Regulation (EC) No 765/2008 responsible for carrying out accreditation with authority.
A body of experts established to advise the AI Office, especially on GPAI systemic risks and technical matters.
A capability that equals or surpasses the capabilities recorded in the most advanced GPAI models, and which may pose systemic risks.

A change to the AI system after its placing on the market or putting into service which is not foreseen or planned in the initial conformity assessment and which affects the compliance of the system with this Regulation.

voce.termineEN: Safety component of a product or system
voce.traduzioneIT: Componente di sicurezza di un prodotto o sistema
voce.definizioneEN: A component of a product or of a system which serves to fulfil a safety function for that product or system, or the failure or malfunctioning of which endangers the health and safety of persons or property.
A component of a product or system that performs a safety function, the failure or malfunction of which endangers health, safety, or fundamental rights.
A conformity assessment body designated in accordance with this Regulation to carry out conformity assessment tasks.
A continuous iterative process run throughout the entire lifecycle of a high-risk AI system, requiring regular updates, monitoring, and mitigation of risks.
A controlled framework set up by a competent authority that facilitates the development, testing, and validation of innovative AI systems under strict regulatory oversight.
A European standard as defined in Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012 on European standardisation.
A form of AI where models are embedded in agents that can autonomously perform complex tasks, including planning, interaction with digital/physical environments, and collaboration with other agents.
A formalised system that documents processes, procedures, and responsibilities for achieving quality policies and objectives, ensuring compliance with this Regulation for high-risk AI systems.

A machine-based system that, for explicit or implicit objectives, infers how to generate outputs such as predictions, content, recommendations, or decisions that can influence physical or virtual environments.
A marking by which the provider indicates that an AI system or GPAI model is in conformity with the requirements of this Regulation and other applicable Union harmonisation legislation.
